# DrifterApps.Seeds.FluentResult

> Railway-Oriented Programming (ROP) Result pattern library for .NET 10. Every operation that can fail returns `Result<T>` — a discriminated union of success (carrying `T`) or failure (carrying `ResultError`) — instead of throwing exceptions or returning null.

Package: `DrifterApps.Seeds.FluentResult`
Namespace: `DrifterApps.Seeds.FluentResult`
Testing package: `DrifterApps.Seeds.FluentResult.FluentAssertions`
